comment: Governance is framed around data quality; §3.4 says nothing about privacy, consent, minimisation, purpose-limitation, or access control (those live only in principles VIII–IX). We recommend treating data protection as a core governance dimension alongside data quality — good governance answers not only "is the data good?" but "is it collected, shared, and accessed lawfully, minimally, and with consent?"

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation
